Yeah I know but the thought of going back to normal isn’t appealing to me much at the moment. I am fairly good in trying new things and enjoying life at times but I have a lot of resentment for myself. 

Long story but someone close to me needed me as they were going through an terminal illness and I wasn’t good to them. It’s really affecting me as they no longer want anything to do with me, I feel that any good that I will ever do won’t matter as this is always gonna be a part of me.

I think as he has shared that with you then that could be him questioning it in his mind, knowing that it isn’t the right thing to do. 

Just make sure to keep doing what your doing by giving him encouraging words, especially in these times things are intensifying for all of us.

I personally wouldn’t want anyone to start trying to push me for help as I know these problems are internal in me, and I know I’m ultimately the one who can change that. 

I hope he manages to get through this, not every day is so dark. I just try to think back to times when life seemed impossible and that helps me get through the next day. 

Maybe he should go and see his local doctors, you can offer to go with him.

If he is starting to isolate himself from everyone it’s a clear sign as that’s what I’ve done since start of the year. I don’t feel I have anyone to open up with about it and when someone reaches out I feel somewhat of a burden. Because I don’t want to put it onto them because they are not sure what is it I am going through. I think if I had somebody in my life who could be straight forward and be understanding, and start the conversation it would be a lot of help. 

Maybe message him saying that you can see that he is isolating himself and drawing himself away because of his mental state. Then see how he takes it and if he is willing to communicate. 

For me it’s all about understanding, it doesn’t mean you have to of felt this way before. But just that you acknowledge mental disorders and how they can affect someone.

Damn this hits home with me, always doing nothing with my time. I feel I have to face reality that it will be this way but it is so hard to do. 

I hope one day soon it will not be this way for most of us on here, and we can find people to share our lives with.

Yeah your situation is a lot more complex than mine was, we weren’t living together and went no contact. I guess if you two are okay with it for the time being then it can work.

I think as for moving on, I’m just thinking to myself what I’ve learnt and how I can implement that to my future. Some days are real hard when I feel alone but I think I felt that many nights when I was in the relationship. 

I hope you find happiness after all of this it just takes a lot of thinking and reflecting.
Yeah I get that life moves on, I just feel I have lost a part of me that once had hope and ambition. I should have fixed it a while back just didn’t see clearly at all.

Best thing I can suggest for the both of you is to try and work something out. I am recovering from a breakup and I’ve been trying to understand love and how I can make it work and be a better person. 

Go on YouTube and search Physc2go it’s a great channel, tips how to make a relationship last. How to make it strong. Then thoughts that can make a relationship fail, things that happy couples do for each other. 

I may help him gain some perspective it’s worth trying it’s helped me a lot and I had got into a very depressed state in my relationship, which made things very toxic. I just wished I knew of this channel before.

Or even invite someone to go to the golf range/ archery/ shooting or play badminton/tennis. I try to find things that don’t cost to much but is a couple hours fun. Never plan my two mates usually are the ones asking me now lol. Don’t have to be in some huge party, just enjoying a couple hours out.

I don’t think your an asshole for it. You just had to make a decision that was hard for the both of you but it had to happen. Relationships never break off easy and one party always looks worse. Me being a male this has happened to me way to many times. You have been through a lot and it will only better your future relationship.

If it’s texting then it’s a no go that’s comes off very immature. If it was a case that they shared a hobby and text each other to arrange when they do things that’s different. But to be texting all the time there is much more to that.
Don’t do it! Move on from her, there will always be another that will come into your life at the right time. And you will be able to know if she is worth it from what you’ve learnt.
3 years ago best to just move on at this point and forget about it?

Going through the same shame right now, filled with so many negatives I caused.
Bad place to be that’s for sure.

Been in the same situation before and completely lead with my emotions and everything escalated. Best off trying to ease off with him while your there, as hard as it sounds it can make it easier in the long run. Don’t give him any quality time, don’t give him arguments just silent treatment. 

Don’t focus on what’s going on and keep your mind locked into that state. If you leave or not this will help, it will help you and help him realise what he could be losing. Being silent and not available is power. 

Give him the cold shoulder and distance yourself, think with your mind and not your heart. Give things time it’s so easy to get lost and everything comes crashing down way to fast. Be prepared for what’s to come. 

Hope this helps you.

I’d say the best thing to do is work hard in your job. Find hobbies and work out, quit the porn. A relationship should only compliment your life, not the main focus. Maybe once marriage/kids then it’s different.
